title: An autopilot tick plans and runs sprints a headless runner can work, and passes over started sprints that are operator-present only
goal: When every started sprint is refused by runner start as operator-present only, the tick still plans: step 5.1 takes only a started sprint that runner start would accept (bl_plan.guarded_items empty), the plan subagent commits only items whose touches a headless runner may edit, and an operator-present sprint is named once in the digest, not retried each tick; today 9 of the 10 active sprints and 49 of 81 open items touch guarded files, so an unattended tick starts nothing and plans nothing

gates.question: Most open work touches files a headless runner may not edit (49 of 81 open items, 9 of 10 active sprints). What should the unattended autopilot run?
options: headless-only: it plans and runs only sprints whose items a headless runner may edit; tooling sprints stay operator-present
widen: let a headless runner edit bl_ modules and existing tests, inside the container only
pause: keep the autopilot off until the tooling sprints drain
gates.recommendation: headless-only: it plans and runs only sprints whose items a headless runner may edit; tooling sprints stay operator-present
gates.answer: widen: let a headless runner edit bl_ modules and existing tests, inside the container only

notes: Theme: what the autopilot can run unattended. Evidence: autopilot.guarded_refusal over the active sprints on 2026-10-04: only SP-rq4t477t is headless-runnable, and its next item ST-32b46kff is operator-present by its own gates; bl_authority.guarded_touches flags 49 of 81 open non-epic items; kb-autopilot SKILL.md step 5.1 takes a started sprint with ready work before planning, and 5.3 does not retry an operator-present refusal but says nothing of planning in its place. The gate on this item asks the operator what the autopilot is for. | OPERATOR ANSWER 2026-10-04 (g1): WIDEN, container only: inside the container a headless runner may edit bl_ modules and existing tests. Until the container exists (ST-32b46kff) this story is the interim behaviour (headless-only tick); the widening is the follow-up story filed for the container rollout.
